title: Transcriber's cover note, 1994
summary: A WNYC cover note dated 3/2/94 from the transcriber, David Carp, sending the transcript of the 6/6/82 session to the archive.

story.theme_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x:
Hi Don,

Enclosed is a transcript that I made
of one day's worth (6/6/82) of the
Benny Waters interview done for the
JOHP. I figured you guys would
want a copy of this...

Best,
David Carp
